de: John Milton publishes Areopagitica, a pamphlet decrying censorship.

t: 在被判叛国罪7天后,伪装出英格兰王位的珀金·沃贝克(Perkin Warbeck)因试图从伦敦…
te: Seven days after being convicted of treason, Perkin Warbeck, a pretender to the throne of England, is hanged for attemp…
dz: 在被判叛国罪7天后,伪装出英格兰王位的珀金·沃贝克(Perkin Warbeck)因试图从伦敦塔逃跑被绞死;他的支持者约翰·阿特沃特被处死.
de: Seven days after being convicted of treason, Perkin Warbeck, a pretender to the throne of England, is hanged for attempting to escape from the Tower of London; his supporter John Atwater is executed with him.

t: 卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南三世手下的基督教军队征服了塞维利亚.
te: Conquest of Seville by Christian troops under King Ferdinand III of Castile.
dz: 卡斯蒂利亚国王斐迪南三世手下的基督教军队征服了塞维利亚.
de: Conquest of Seville by Christian troops under King Ferdinand III of Castile.

t: "伊卡利亚"(Thespis of Icaria)成为第一位在舞台上描绘出角色的被录制演员.
te: Thespis of Icaria becomes the first recorded actor to portray a character on stage.
dz: "伊卡利亚"(Thespis of Icaria)成为第一位在舞台上描绘出角色的被录制演员.
de: Thespis of Icaria becomes the first recorded actor to portray a character on stage.
